categories.title: Cellar
categories.info: **Cellars spawn randomly** and are **not guaranteed to be found**. Cellars can potentially spawn Elite Enemies, Events, Shrines, or even multiple Treasure Goblins.

categories.title: Dungeon
categories.info: Dungeons are a semi-random tile set, they may include random events, puzzles or bosses like The Butcher

categories.title: Shrine
categories.info: Shrines  spawns are not guaranteed - they have a random chance of appearing in set locations.

categories.title: Altar of Lilith
categories.info: Activating an Altar of Lilith will grant XP to your current character and the Altar's Realm Power to all your characters.

categories.title: Chronicle of Creation
categories.info: Find the Lilith and Inarius statues nearby and interact with them until they create a link to this statue.  Then interact with this statue to claim your reward

categories.title: Tenet of Akarat
categories.info:
Solve the puzzle using the nearby Stone Guardian statues, to cleanse the Defiled Shrine.    
**Reward:** 
- Nahantu Renown
- XP
- Mount & Player Title (must unlock all 30 statues)

categories.title: World Boss
categories.info: **Note:** World Bosses  spawn only after the story campaign has been completed.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chest  spawns are not guaranteed - they have a random chance of appearing in set locations.  Any Chest may randomly spawn as a Silent Chest.  To open a Silent Chest - spend Murmuring Obols.

categories.title: Zone Event
categories.info: Zone Events spawn regularly at fixed locations around the map.  They are meant to be undertaken by multiple players to attain the best rewards.  Activate the Campfire before the Zone Event for an XP buff.

categories.title: Accursed Ritual
categories.info: Accursed Rituals require 3 Baneful Hearts to initiate.  They consist of multiple waves of enemies, elites, and a Blood Maiden miniboss.

categories.title: Helltide Chest
categories.info:
Tortured Gift chest spawns are not guaranteed - they have a random chance of appearing in set locations, only during the Helltide event, as seen on your in-game map.  Chests cost 100 Aberrant Cinders.  

**Note:** Helltide requires campaign completion.  Helltide is up for 55 minutes, and down for 5 minutes, before coming back up again in a new random region.  Kill enemies to collect Aberrant Cinders, used to open Helltide Chests.  Dying during Helltide will cause you to lose a chunk of Aberrant Cinders.
